description: A glass building façade begins to shift at night. Panels fold out, rotate, and pull back to form a giant Rolex watch face embedded into the building. Gears rotate behind the windows, and the city skyline reflects off the crystal-clear dial. Golden lights ripple around the structure like time itself is ticking through the skyline.
camera: dolly-up from street level, upward sweep to the skyline, dramatic pullback
lighting: golden city lights with cool glass glows
atmosphere: quiet prestige, wind ambiance, ticking sounds
elements: building façade rotating to reveal giant Rolex watch
moving internal gears visible through windows
glowing outlines of hour marks forming from lights
motion: building morphs into product from glass and steel plates, time pulses across scene
cta_motion: Rolex logo illuminates across the top of the skyscraper like a crown
ending: watch embedded in tower glass, shimmering with skyline reflections
